title: two proofs read a block's trace through learning_block's name
intention: test_skilldial and test_intent_skill name each block's trace file through learning_block.trace_path, so they read the file fire() writes on every box.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 (Linux census, 6cbae796b): both proofs red with FileNotFoundError on traces/skill:wired.jsonl and skill:intent.jsonl; since a9709b744bf5 (f96e37be2) the door writes skill__<name>.jsonl.
traces_to: Law 8 (a red a peer cannot lean on) and Law 3 (the tooth reads the trace the door wrote).
how: test_skilldial.py:115 and test_intent_skill.py:195 take learning_block.trace_path(<block>, traces) in place of the literal name. No production code changes.

clauses.claim: test_skilldial.py is green under a scratch HOME on Linux and its reading-never-writes tooth reads the file fire() wrote
test_intent_skill.py is green under a scratch HOME on Linux and still reds when fire() writes no trace line

decisions.text: D1: test_skilldial.py:115 names its trace file as learning_block.trace_path('skill:wired', traces); PROVES gains this ticket's clause 1.
D2: test_intent_skill.py:195 reads trace_path('skill:intent', traces); PROVES gains clause 2.

measured.how: each proof run alone under a scratch HOME (~/.akien/temp/cn/home), venv python, Linux, at 6cbae796b
